name: Fresno
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fresno for 2026, and here is what he found: 24 family events, 12 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Photos with Santa at Fashion Fair, Christmas at Kearney and ZooLights) through January 3 (Christmas at Kearney: Sounds of the Season), with Christmas Tree Lane (December 1 to 25), the Fresno Philharmonic's Home for the Holidays (December 5) and Holiday FAMily Day at Fresno Art Museum (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fresno

  • 24 Christmas events for kids in Fresno, including Kerman, Coalinga and Riverdale
  • 12 free events, including Christmas Tree Lane, Photos with Santa at Fashion Fair and Holiday FAMily Day at Fresno Art Museum
  • Meet Santa: Fashion Fair Center Court (November 27 to December 24), the Kearney Mansion Santa Meet and Greet (December 5 and 6) and Breakfast with Santa in Kerman (December 12)
  • Parades and lights: Christmas Tree Lane, the Club Onederland lighting ceremony (November 29), the Coalinga Christmas parade (December 5) and ZooLights
  • Shows: Home for the Holidays with the Fresno Philharmonic (December 5)
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to January 3, 2027
